base_material: ASTM A36 Structural Carbon Steel (Weldable & Formable)
microstructure: Primary M7C3 hexagonal chromium carbides (1500–1800 HV micro-hardness) densely distributed within a tough austenitic matrix.
primary_application: Severe sliding abrasion combined with moderate impact (e.g. glass batch hammermill screens, cement clinker chutes, asphalt aggregate hoppers).
comparison_vs_ar500: Lasts 3.5x to 5.0x longer than AR500 / Hardox 500 under severe sliding silica abrasion.

microstructure: Ultra-high volume fraction of hexagonal chromium carbides.
primary_application: Extreme sliding abrasion with zero-to-low impact (fine powders, coal dust, fly ash pipelines).
limitation: Not recommended for high-impact drop zones; specify Allied 300XL for impact resistance.

chemistry_limits: Carbon max 0.23%, Manganese 0.50–1.60%, Silicon max 0.40%, Vanadium max 0.11%
dual_certification: Certified to meet both ASTM A992 and ASTM A36 structural building standards.

classification: Standard Carbon Structural Steel (Channels, Angles, Base Plates)
chemistry_limits: Carbon max 0.25%, Manganese balance, Phosphorus max 0.04%, Sulfur max 0.05%
machinability_and_welding: Excellent weldability with AWS E7018 or ER70S-6 wire without high preheat requirements.
